subject.title: feat: add Computer Use plugin manifest contract

question: Should OpenClaw accept `contracts.computerUseProviders` and `computerUseProviderMetadata` as a public metadata-only plugin manifest contract for macOS Computer Use discovery with these field names and discovery-only permission semantics?
rationale: The implementation is additive, but once released these fields become plugin-author API surface and are meant to inform host binding around Accessibility and Screen Recording permissions.

options.title: Accept after docs and owner confirmation
options.body: Regenerate the docs map, confirm host code treats this metadata as discovery-only, and then proceed with the additive manifest contract.

options.title: Revise the contract shape first
options.body: Rename or narrow the field names, platform shape, permission enum, or MCP metadata before freezing the public plugin contract.

options.title: Pause for host design alignment
options.body: Keep the PR draft until the macOS host discovery and trust-boundary design is settled enough to publish the manifest surface.

recommendation.title: Accept after docs and owner confirmation
recommendation.body: Regenerate the docs map, confirm host code treats this metadata as discovery-only, and then proceed with the additive manifest contract.
